head: codex/4647-v0917-review-remediation-preflight
title: [v0.91.7][WP-20] Remediate external review findings (#4647)
body:
Closes #4647

Records WP-20 remediation of the retained WP-19 external review findings for v0.91.7.

Highlights:
- Retains the exact external finding-validation artifact and WP-19 remediation matrix.
- Fixes Bedrock account pinning and diagnostic redaction, provider artifact retry safety, coverage profile isolation, CSM redaction/path hygiene, local provider edge cases, and current milestone documentation truth.
- Repairs PR #5588 CI fallout after publication: coverage-impact mapping was fixed after canceled run 29718251274, clippy warnings were fixed after canceled run 29718818086, CSM API Gateway response finalization was fixed after adl-coverage-hosted failed run 29719551279, and PR coverage report-renderer crash handling was fixed after adl-coverage-hosted failed run 29721377401.
- Latest exact-head review at aea910bddf047730f32da0bc31c556ebe86e5097 by subagent 019f7e46-a24a-7f62-b24e-c3b5d9202d63 was CLEAN/fixed-confirmed for the post-publication PR coverage report-renderer repair.

Validation:
- Focused WP-20 validation is recorded in the SOR and remediation matrix.
- Bedrock sanitizer partition coverage: 4 focused tests passed on FastWork.
- Post-clippy local proof recorded in SOR: cargo fmt passed; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings passed; provider::http_family::tests::bedrock_invocation_artifact passed 5 tests; provider::local::tests::ollama_streaming_buffers_split_multibyte_utf8 passed 1 test.
- Post-coverage-hosted CSM proof recorded in SOR: cargo test csm_runtime_api::api_gateway_bridge::tests::api_gateway_bridge_ passed 4 tests; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings passed; cargo llvm-cov nextest with the same bridge filter passed 4 tests.
- Post-coverage-hosted report-renderer proof recorded in SOR: bash adl/tools/test_run_authoritative_coverage_lane.sh passed; bash adl/tools/test_ci_runtime_contracts.sh passed; bash -n adl/tools/run_authoritative_coverage_lane.sh adl/tools/test_run_authoritative_coverage_lane.sh passed.
- Changed-path-vs-protected-path check over origin/main...HEAD returned no output after typed scope amendments for adl/src/csm_api_gateway_bridge.rs and .csdlc/publication/4647.intent.json.
- csdlc-doctor passed for #4647 at generation 43 reviewed after the latest repair.

Non-claims:
- No AWS live operation was run.
- This does not reopen WP-18.
- WP-23 remains separate until WP-20 is merged and closed.
